amendments.normalized_body: Blocking: this patch does not implement the requested rooted-plant substrate oxygenation hook. The changed behavior is nitrification alkalinity accounting/tracing in `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:224-241`, `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:366-385`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:6-27`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/budget.rs:68-125`, and `crates/tank_core/src/systems/water_change.rs:128-152`, and the new coverage in `crates/tank_core/tests/nitrification_alkalinity.rs:1-336` is also about alkalinity. Meanwhile `crates/tank_core/src/systems/plant_growth.rs:22-24` still explicitly says oxic/suboxic root-zone coupling is future work, and there are still no code changes for substrate O2 penetration depth, rooted-vs-floating plant contribution, biomass-based saturation, habitat-registry queries for root activity, or root oxygenation tracing. As submitted, rooted plants still cannot change substrate oxygen penetration or the downstream nitrification/denitrification behavior required by the bead.
